# SCP-3008: The Infinite IKEA

> SCP-3008: The Infinite IKEA is a free multiplayer first-person survival horror game that runs in the browser, based on the SCP Foundation entry SCP-3008, "A Perfectly Normal, Regular Old IKEA." You are trapped inside an endless IKEA: by day its faceless staff wander aimlessly, and at night they turn hostile and hunt you down.

Features: an infinite, chunk-based procedurally generated IKEA interior (living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens and more); SCP-3008-2 entities, faceless humanoids in yellow shirts and blue pants; a day/night cycle that switches the staff from passive to aggressive; real-time multiplayer with in-game chat; and survival mechanics (health, sprinting, death). Controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, Shift to sprint, Enter to open chat, Esc to close it, click to lock the cursor. Built with React, TypeScript, Three.js (react-three-fiber) and Socket.io. A fan game based on SCP-3008 by Mortos, licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0.
